purpose: Acquire the official x64 Node 12.14.1 runtime for darwin so the repository-declared cell (package.json engines.node 12.14.1, .nvmrc v12.14.1, check-node-version prebuild) could be executed under Rosetta 2 on darwin-arm64.

digestVerification.method: shasum -a 256 -c against the line for node-v12.14.1-darwin-x64.tar.gz extracted from the official SHASUMS256.txt fetched in the same consented window

attempts.stderrTail: arch: posix_spawnp: ./node-v12.14.1-darwin-x64/bin/node: Bad CPU type in executable

rosettaProbe.question: Is Rosetta 2 present, so that an x86_64 Mach-O binary can be translated on this arm64 host?

controlProbe.stderrTail: arch: posix_spawnp: /usr/bin/true: Bad CPU type in executable
controlProbe.interpretation: This system binary does contain an x86_64 slice, so the refusal is not a missing slice. It is the absence of the translation layer.

rosettaProbe.conclusion: Rosetta 2 is not installed on this host.
rosettaProbe.remediationNotAttempted: Installing Rosetta 2 requires `softwareupdate --install-rosetta`, which needs administrator privileges, an interactive licence acceptance, and a network fetch outside this unit's recorded allowance. It mutates the host rather than the repository, so it was not attempted.

nonclaims: A verified runtime digest establishes only that the bytes on disk match the bytes nodejs.org published for this release. It establishes no signer authenticity: the official SHASUMS256.txt was fetched over TLS and its detached GPG signature was not checked against a key this unit holds.
The runtime was acquired and verified but never executed, so this record is not evidence about how any project behaves under Node 12.14.1.
No install, build, browser behavior, migration feasibility, pilot status, or production readiness is established by this record.
